verdict.rationale: First-party docs say merchants can set up B2B Edition for wholesale and enterprise buyers, with company accounts, quotes and custom pricing. A dedicated B2B ecommerce solution page backs this up, so the core of the story is covered. The evidence is thin and only marketing- or quick-start-level, and B2B Edition appears to be a distinct edition rather than a default capability. Missing for 10: volume or tiered pricing evidence, net-terms invoicing evidence, detail on customer-specific price lists, explicit confirmation of running B2B alongside DTC on one store, independent or hands-on corroboration.
